# Overview

**PredLDA** implements predictive linear discriminant analysis through an R6
class aligned with scikit-learn conventions: `fit()`, `predict()`,
`predict_proba()`, `score()`, `print()` and `summary()`.

```{r}
library(PredLDA)
```

# Fit and inspect a model

```{r}
model <- LDA$new()
model$fit(iris[, 1:4], iris$Species)
model
```

Classification functions are stored in `coefficients` (one column per class,
intercept in the first row):

```{r}
round(model$coefficients, 3)
```

Class means and priors:

```{r}
round(model$means, 3)
model$priors
```

# Predict classes and probabilities

```{r}
new_obs <- iris[c(1, 51, 101), 1:4]
model$predict(new_obs)
round(model$predict_proba(new_obs), 4)
model$score(iris[, 1:4], iris$Species)
```

Columns of `X` are matched **by name** at prediction time, so column order may
differ from training.

# Example files shipped with the package

```{r}
extdir <- system.file("extdata", package = "PredLDA")
list.files(extdir)

train <- read.delim(file.path(extdir, "iris_apprentissage.tsv"),
                    check.names = FALSE)
newdata <- read.delim(file.path(extdir, "iris_nouveaux.tsv"),
                      check.names = FALSE)

xcols <- c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", "Petal.Length", "Petal.Width")
m <- LDA$new()$fit(train[, xcols], train$Species)
data.frame(
  predicted = as.character(m$predict(newdata)),
  round(m$predict_proba(newdata[, xcols]), 4),
  Identifiant = newdata$Identifiant
)
```

# Shiny application

```r
# Requires Suggests package 'shiny'
shiny::runApp(system.file("shiny", package = "PredLDA"))
```

See `system.file("shiny/README.md", package = "PredLDA")` for a click-by-click
reproducible walkthrough.

# Reading `summary()`

```{r}
invisible(model$summary())
```

For two-class problems, `summary()` also prints
\(D(x) = d_1(x) - d_2(x)\). Predict class 1 when \(D(x) > 0\).
